name.description: A human-readable name for the service.

addons.description: List of addons to enable for the service. 'time-series' enables TimescaleDB, 'ai' enables AI/vector extensions.

region_code.description: The region where the service will be created. If not provided, we'll choose the best region for you.

replica_count.description: Number of high-availability replicas to create (all replicas are asynchronous by default).

cpu_millis.description: The initial CPU allocation in milli-cores, or 'shared' for a shared-resource service.

memory_gbs.description: The initial memory allocation in gigabytes, or 'shared' for a shared-resource service.

environment_tag.description: The environment tag for the service, 'DEV' by default.
